title: eriolaena glaberrima
intro: Eriolaena glaberrima, commonly known as the Red-flowered Eriolaena, is a species of plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is a woody climber found in the tropical forests of the Western Ghats, India. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Eriolaena glaberrima include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive effects.
